result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: one missing restaurant image and one layout overlap at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The first item under "Popular right now" shows a broken image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load the restaurant image correctly, and if the asset is unavailable, replace it with a proper fallback thumbnail or error state.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content look cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add extra bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so cards are fully visible above the navigation bar.
